segments.text:
Ninthly, All that come to Christ •…e taught of God to abandon their former wayes and companions in sin as ever they expect to be received unto mercy, Isai. 55. 7. 2 Cor. 5. 17. Sins that were profitable and pleasant, as the right hand, and right eye, must now be cut off. Companions in sin, who were once the delight of their lives, must now be cast off. Christ saith to the soul concerning these, as he said in another case, John 18. 8. if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way: and the soul saith unto Christ as it is Psalm 119. 115. depart
from me ye evil doers, for I will keep the Commandments of my God: and now pleasant sins, and companions in sin become the very burthen and shame of a mans soul: objects of delight are become objects of pity and compassion: no endearments, no union of blood, no earthly interests whatsoever are found strong enough to hold the soul any longer from Christ: nothing but the effectual teachings of God is found sufficient to dissolve such bonds of iniquity as these.
